tagline: Powering the communities we serve through rate-regulated infrastructure investment
hero_kpi_rationale: The rate base is the primary growth driver for regulated utilities like Ameren, as it determines allowed revenues through regulation and reflects investments in energy infrastructure.

kpis.name: Rate Base
kpis.explanation: Value of regulated assets on which the company is allowed to earn a regulated return.
kpis.description: The rate base grows steadily through investments in transmission, distribution, and generation, supporting growth in regulated revenues.
kpis.signal: Sustained rate base growth driven by investments in regulated infrastructure.

kpis.name: Allowed ROE
kpis.explanation: Regulator-approved return on equity for regulated assets.
kpis.description: Allowed ROE varies by segment: 10.48% for Ameren Transmission, 8.72% for Illinois Electric, and 9.60% for Illinois Gas.
kpis.signal: High ROE on transmission, the most profitable segment.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenues and direct costs, expressed as a percentage of revenues.
kpis.description: Gross margin is stable and high, typical of regulated utilities with cost recovery mechanisms.
kpis.signal: High gross margin due to regulation and cost predictability.

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenues.
kpis.description: Operating margin is slightly improving due to disciplined cost management.
kpis.signal: Improving operational efficiency despite the regulated environment.

kpis.name: Capex
kpis.explanation: Annual spending on new assets or infrastructure improvements.
kpis.description: Sustained capital expenditures aim to enhance grid reliability and meet decarbonization goals.
kpis.signal: Capex rising significantly to modernize the grid and integrate clean energy.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of full-time employees in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount is slightly decreasing due to automation and process optimization.
kpis.signal: Slight reduction in headcount despite rate base growth.

kpis.name: Revenue Requirement Increase
kpis.explanation: Additional amount authorized to be charged to customers following a rate case review.
kpis.description: In April 2025, the MoPSC approved a $355 million increase in revenue requirement for Ameren Missouri, effective June 2025.
kpis.signal: Clear regulatory recognition of past investments.

kpis.name: Future Test Year
kpis.explanation: Regulatory change allowing the use of future-period data to set rates.
kpis.description: The PPRA allows Ameren Missouri to use a future test year for gas rates starting July 2026.
kpis.signal: Modernization of the regulatory framework to better align investments with recovery.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury).
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + share buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Regulatory Framework
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to extensive regulation at the federal, state, and local levels. Changes in regulatory frameworks can have a significant impact on the company's results.

risks.title: Environmental Compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict environmental laws and regulations, and compliance costs can be significant.

risks.title: Climate Change Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces risks related to climate change, including initiatives to reduce carbon emissions.

risks.title: Regulated Rates
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to regulated rates, and changes in laws and regulations can impact its results.

risks.title: Capital Expenditure Requirements
risks.score_rationale: The company faces significant capital expenditure requirements to comply with environmental laws and regulations.

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to potential litigation related to non-compliance with environmental laws and regulations.

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces reputational risks, particularly in the event of non-compliance with environmental laws.

risks.title: Financing Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks related to financing infrastructure investments and regulatory compliance.
